requirements.title: Restore existing intelligent CN/MM
requirements.scope: G00–G12, M01–M11 unchanged; real typed MM translation, scorecard, source-to-consumer influence, seven-day forecast and natural production/CDN proof. Historical UNKNOWN preserved.
requirements.acceptance: All original gates evidenced; no fallback presented as model intelligence.

requirements.title: Historical source and capability inventory
requirements.scope: Recover old active/shadow/retired sensors, exact transforms, clocks, provenance, ownership, consumers, prior falsification and missing data. Inventory data available as-of vs reconstructed. Use existing legacy map.
requirements.acceptance: Every claimed active sensor reaches its intended consumer; missing/retired/negative sources explicitly classified.

requirements.title: Replay architecture and data qualification
requirements.scope: Reuse Historical Reality Engine, existing Backtest Build, m1/m3/m6 replay, historical_altseason_pullback_v1 and sensor recovery. Freeze point-in-time universe, source clocks, split, label and evaluation manifest. No Round 3 outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: Future mutation cannot change as-of feature; actual replay reproducible at pinned code and data; strict missing/late/revised tests.

requirements.title: Rolling daily forecasts vs immutable Monday
requirements.scope: Append daily issue vintages from existing authorized owner only; retain original weekly freeze. Distinct observed time, issue time, target time, supersession, model/generation mode. 1/3/7/14/21/30d BTC/ETH and eligible investable ALT benchmark; 0–12h and 4–8w existing; 3–6mo scenarios research only.
requirements.acceptance: No prior vintage changed; paired daily and weekly errors scored after maturation, actual publication and exact as-of readback.

requirements.title: Coherent probabilistic price paths
requirements.scope: Daily close quantiles, signed-return distribution, low/high joint envelope separately defined, cross-horizon coherent scenarios, tail-risk and turning windows. Use joint paths not independent day quantiles for event probabilities.
requirements.acceptance: No impossible OHLC or crossed quantiles; empirical calibration, width/CRPS/pinball/MAE versus persistence and volatility baselines per horizon.

requirements.title: Direction and magnitude scoring
requirements.scope: Separate up/flat/down with predeclared deadband; benchmark sign/base-rate/persistence; magnitude and tails by regime; abstention and complete denominator.
requirements.acceptance: Paired balanced accuracy, Brier/log score, error and coverage; no claim from high hit rate alone.

requirements.title: Champion/challenger tournament
requirements.scope: Preserve C0/C1/C2 names and frozen contracts. Additional families only if unique: EWMA/AR/regularized, LightGBM/XGBoost, Chronos-2/TimesFM, regime-conditioned ensemble. No model replacement before admitted evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Pinned model/version/license/training cutoff, equal inputs, same holdout and compute; compare to best predeclared simple baseline; reject unnecessary complexity.

requirements.title: Sensor marginal value and interactions
requirements.scope: Existing CCE/FAE/SRE/RWE/ODM owners: ablation, paired addition, interaction, feature lag/threshold robustness, sequence order and confirmation delay, signal redundancy, negative transfer. Nested tuning only.
requirements.acceptance: Out-of-sample paired gain with uncertainty per horizon/regime; no automatic weights, one registered delta/family.

requirements.title: Mass replay and resource efficiency
requirements.scope: Staged search, small deterministic baseline first; reuse cached immutable feature matrices, vectorized NumPy/Polars, DuckDB/Parquet only if admissible, local CPU; block bootstrap/stress simulations separate from independent samples.
requirements.acceptance: Record every attempted variant including rejected; exact reproducibility and cost/time; scale only when marginal evidence justifies; no new CI dispatch or paid API.

requirements.title: Calibration and drift
requirements.scope: M07/M05 first: compare rolling quantile calibration, adaptive conformal and ensemble weights with only matured eligible data. Drift/structural break tests, cold-start fallback, no leakage.
requirements.acceptance: Empirical coverage plus sharpness; score by horizon/era, safety on rare tails and degradation; revert candidate when inferior.

requirements.title: Cycle phase observation taxonomy
requirements.scope: Reuse PATH v3 ten phases and source-owned protection/sell/reentry; current phase vs transition forecast separated; offline labels fixed before test, UNKNOWN and competing phases explicit.
requirements.acceptance: Same-clock labels with source evidence; no browser inference, no mandatory linear sequence, no relabel after outcome.

requirements.title: 14–30d cycle transition forecast
requirements.scope: Discrete competing-risk hazard or regularized multi-state model before HMM/semi-Markov; probability of first transition by 7/14/21/30d, no-event, backward/skipped phases, risk-off and censored episodes.
requirements.acceptance: Monotonic cumulative incidence per event, coherent competing probabilities, time-dependent Brier/calibration vs phase persistence/base-rate; abstain if independent N inadequate.

requirements.title: Altseason outcome labels and universe
requirements.scope: Reuse shared-row-altseason Nov5 audit, T6, M4/M6. Separate ETHBTC from broad altcoin takeoff; frozen investable cap/liquidity tiers, historical membership incl delisted, equal/cap weighted indices, relative BTC/ETH returns and persistence.
requirements.acceptance: No ETHBTC-only surrogate, survivorship or hindsight; distinguish ignition, broad acceleration, failure and distribution; independent episode counts.

requirements.title: Rotation and transition signals
requirements.scope: BTC/ETH/large/mid/small/micro/meme pathways; ETHBTC, BTC.D, breadth survival, liquidity/ETF absorption, stablecoin deployment, funding/OI/reclaim, CFGI, sequence and false-start tests.
requirements.acceptance: Lead-time vs false alerts, missed opportunities, duration, breadth participation and baseline; no forced linear rotation.

requirements.title: Entry decision policy research
requirements.scope: Simulate early accumulation vs confirmation vs pullback/reclaim vs abstention; use same opportunity set and costs; existing Paper Wallet only. Define barrier hits, adverse excursion, timing and delayed confirmation opportunity cost.
requirements.acceptance: No hindsight optimal entry as executable policy; benchmark fixed exposure/hold/periodic and simple rules; report all candidate episodes and after-cost results.

requirements.title: Exit and re-entry decision research
requirements.scope: Existing protection/sell/reentry, M6 and pullback radar. Compare staged exit, trailing, distribution, momentum, cycle exit, reentry; false exit and missed upside vs protection. Holder vs cash states distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Net simulated wealth, drawdown, tail loss, turnover, avoided loss and false exits on identical capital/risk budget; no live trades.

requirements.title: Kompas to Alpha/Paper regime conditioning
requirements.scope: Existing authorized regime contract as optional time-valid paper feature; compare unconditioned vs conditioned on same candidates/fees, liquidity, capacity and source admission; no second paper engine.
requirements.acceptance: Paired incremental net value; full position exit feasibility, rejected assets, failed fills and costs; no private export; negative results retained.

requirements.title: Economic attribution and search multiplicity
requirements.scope: All trial IDs and rejected variants, clustered episodes, realistic entry/exit spread/slippage/gas, venue limits, delisted tokens, selection-adjusted inference where valid.
requirements.acceptance: No selected winner declared alpha without untouched prospective evidence; preserve E0 STOP_PRE_F and Grok errata; no Round 3 scoring.

requirements.title: Precision accountability and learning
requirements.scope: Existing scorecard, Research Genome and Compounding Learning; first-mature outcome, baseline-relative loss, immutable version attribution, false positive/negative taxonomy, uncertainty and historical negative results.
requirements.acceptance: One source-bound outcome per eligible decision; no duplicate scoreboard authority, proven effect distinguished from merge or activity.

requirements.title: Public Kompas product contract
requirements.scope: Versioned source-owned daily/weekly/14–30d forecast schema: issue age, calibrated/experimental/unknown, direction, phase probabilities, interval, next confirmation, invalidation, coverage. Existing public allowlist only.
requirements.acceptance: Actual producer→consumer→CDN exact readback, compact empty state, missing/stale/unknown handling; no UI-generated forecast.

requirements.title: Navigator One Forward and Cycle Journey
requirements.scope: Read public Kompas source at runtime; 7/14/21/30 selector, Monday vs rolling vintages, current phase and branching milestones, entry/exit research markers, current vs forecast explicitly separate.
requirements.acceptance: Mobile/desktop test; no duplicate authority, no synthetic real data, no unapproved private pointer.

requirements.title: Navigator One Precision Lab and Strategy Arena
requirements.owner: existing Navigator One design owner/1596/Alpha owners
requirements.scope: Display model tournament, historical replay, sensor contribution, calibration curve, precision version timeline and paper results only from approved authoritative data; no invented performance.
requirements.acceptance: Every visible result links to version, cohort, baseline and maturity; no data => honest unavailable; private data owner-only.

requirements.title: Plugin and OSS admission
requirements.scope: Audit prior OSS catalog; evaluate Hugging Face, Binance, Blockscout, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, Firecrawl, TinyFish, Scite, Financial Datasets as candidates; investigate public PIT history and actual access/cost. No runtime assumption.
requirements.acceptance: Provider rights, limits, timestamps, history, cost and source contracts checked; read-only no subscriptions, no signing or creds in files.

requirements.title: Adaptive scientific closure
requirements.scope: Existing handoff cap and original code owners; every requirement gets DEDUP/IMPLEMENTED with receipt, EXPERIMENT_REQUIRED, BLOCKED with trigger or REJECTED with evidence. Future FRONTIER generation reconciles outcomes.
requirements.acceptance: No administrative closure, no duplicate agents/workflows, no unreviewed release, no hidden missing requirement; record actual next action.
